authorization: 2026-09-15 user: derive source-judgment regions from previous experiment results, run experiments in background, show every stage.
scope: Non-confirmatory bounded source-assembly and gsplat planar-2D optimization comparison; fresh primitives, no old Gaussian-ID admission requirement.

preparation.authority: Only the frozen P2 11 and P3 2 observation-gate-admitted exact 7x7 patches. P1 has no selected patch. No region dilation or GT-derived source choice.
preparation.replacement: Record all original prior seed IDs within actual admitted prior patch footprint and depth-consistent with that prior hypothesis; preserve others.
preparation.normal_validity: Derive raw geometric normals only where valid finite neighbors exist; omit invalid seeds with counts.
preparation.sampling_control: Same three parent reference cameras, stride and insertion of exact candidate/control patch pixels in both arms; retain stable source IDs and actual point-count differences.
preparation.view_selection: Three parent reference cameras plus unique bound selected/control neighbors; fixed native integer RGB grid.
preparation.projected_support: Diagnostic only; exact projected prior/MVS support has no new MVS authority. Suppress conflicting depth/normal supervision in both arms while retaining RGB.
preparation.depth_valid: Same fixed paired source-valid domain in both arms; no alpha-dependent denominator or depth filling.
preparation.geometry_scope: Selected source patch primitives are eligible for bounded geometry optimization. Outside primitives keep xyz,normal,scale,opacity; RGB appearance may optimize.

training.loss_reduction: Fixed target/context strata, normalize by their own fixed valid counts; skip empty terms explicitly. Photo mask independent of after-alpha.
training.appearance: RGB features, shared configuration across arms
training.camera_order: Persisted deterministic order identical across arms
training.renderer_depth: Unmodified gsplat 1.4 alpha-weighted Gaussian center camera-Z; not exact surfel ray-intersection depth.
training.camera_adapter: Original rays use integer pixels; renderer principal point +0.5 validated by preflight.
training.status: Bounded 2000-step technical comparison; not full unconstrained 2DGS convergence or faithful GeoGS continuation.

resources.wait_for: Existing queue training phase finishes and target GPU is idle; never stop or alter existing jobs.

evaluation.reference_usage: Only separate post-seal evaluation container mounts UAS; never train/prepare.
metrics: paired expected depth and normal change
same-UAS-ID paired distance/coverage and improvement/damage counts
stage_outputs: original RGB and raw Prior/MVS depth
frozen source decision and abstention masks
direct source assembly and preserved context
surrounding damage and separate UAS evaluation
